paragraphs.text: Will McDermott is an American writer and editor. He wrote several stories and novels for Magic: The Gathering . From August 1997 to December 2000 he worked as Editor for Wizards of the Coast 's magazines The Duelist and TopDeck .

After writing a lot of flavor text for early Magic cards, he was asked to write guidebooks for the Urza's block . He wrote short stories for those books that acted as introductions to the larger stories of the sets. Those stories led to short stories in a series of Magic: The Gathering anthologies and his first novel, Judgment .
A Time for Remembrance — The Official Guide to Urza's Saga (November 1998)
Scars of the Legacy — The Official Urza's Legacy Game Guide (April 1999)
Phyrexian Autopsy — The Official Urza's Destiny Game Guide (July 1999)
The Lady of the Mountain — The Myths of Magic anthology (with Daneen McDermott ) (June 2000)
The Journey Home — The Secrets of Magic anthology (May 2002)
Ach! Hans, Run! — The Monsters of Magic anthology (August 2003)
The Moons of Mirrodin — Mirrodin Cycle Book I (September 2003)
